meta.name: weekly-fno-trade-planner
meta.description: Weekly F&O trade planning skill for Indian markets. Analyzes news/macro events, identifies trending sectors and instruments, determines probable direction, suggests option strategy with entry/exit levels, and manages stop-loss and profit booking after position entry. Use when user wants a weekly trade idea, F&O direction call, or ongoing position management for Nifty, Bank Nifty, or stock options.

copy.tagline_en: Plan weekly F&O trades and manage positions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you trade Indian F&O markets and need weekly trade plans and position management.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你分析印度F&O市场，从新闻、板块、技术面到期权策略，生成每周交易计划，并管理持仓止损和止盈。
howto.when: 当你要求每周交易思路、F&O方向判断，或需要管理Nifty、Bank Nifty、个股期权的持仓时触发。

say.text: 帮我做这周Nifty的F&O交易计划。
say.note: Claude会执行完整流程，输出交易卡片。

say.text: 分析Bank Nifty当前方向，给出期权策略。
say.note: Claude会检查技术面和持仓数据，推荐策略。

say.text: 我持有Nifty 23000 CE，帮我管理止损和目标。
say.note: Claude会基于当前价格更新止损和止盈建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes Indian F&O markets from news, sectors, technicals to options strategy, generates a weekly trade plan, and manages stop-loss and profit booking for positions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a weekly trade idea, F&O direction call, or ongoing position management for Nifty, Bank Nifty, or stock options.

say_en.text: Create a weekly F&O trade plan for Nifty.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full workflow and outputs a trade card.

say_en.text: Analyze Bank Nifty direction and suggest an option strategy.
say_en.note: Claude checks technicals and OI data, then recommends a strategy.

say_en.text: I hold Nifty 23000 CE, manage stop-loss and target.
say_en.note: Claude updates stop-loss and profit levels based on current price.
